info.name: SIVA Crackers API
info.description:
All endpoints of the SIVA Crackers backend (see docs/API.md).

Setup: import this collection and "SIVA Crackers – local" environment, fill in your own test account values in the environment (never real passwords in shared files), run "Auth → Get CSRF token" once, then log in. Postman keeps the HttpOnly session cookie; the collection pre-request script copies the XSRF-TOKEN cookie into the X-XSRF-TOKEN header for every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

Local development over http needs APP_COOKIE_SECURE=false with the dev profile (as in backend/.env), otherwise Postman will not send the Secure cookies.

exec: // Copy the CSRF cookie into the header for state-changing requests.
console.warn('No XSRF-TOKEN cookie yet – run "Auth / Get CSRF token" first.');

request.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. Run once before any POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
